== Summary ==
Before/after images for [[Scarif: Citadel Tower (Errata 2)]]: the image of [[Scarif: Citadel Tower (Errata)]] (published 1 June 2022, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/large/scarifcitadeltower.gif holotable e8445f0]) and the image of [[Scarif: Citadel Tower (Errata 2)]] (published 11 June 2022, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6894629d2267392808e0be34eb4aaa7686eced2c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/large/scarifcitadeltower.gif holotable 6894629]). Both whole images side by side, each reduced to 45% (so the two sizes compare as published: 745×534 and 1039×745 pixels). Made from the two published images (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).
